item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of good questions: Does this moment support the life I'm building? Am I projecting or mind reading? Those only work if you actually pause and answer them. Notice that your thoughts are interpretations, not facts. When a negative pattern shows up, name it, then choose a different perspective on purpose. Action: at your next reminder, stop for ten seconds and answer it honestly out loud.
